name: Car Sound
description: Better sound on Gen5W head units: a 5-band equalizer and bass boost on everything Android plays, volume, bass and treble that follow the car's speed, a low-volume loudness lift, and a clip guard. With the car's amplifier (the default on the Bose system) the boosts are made with the car's own Bass, Mid, Treble and volume, on every source, and your own settings come back when Car Sound is off. The Car page also has the car's own speed compensation (Bose DSC or Speed Dependent Volume). Turned off or removed, the sound is as before. Open it from the Car Sound tile in the app menu.
